featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official October Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Daugavpils, traveling through the Baltic area to end in Saint Petersburg.

The event takes place on the **24th October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P2n_zTokGmtO6)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38163.1790793179.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Daugavpils** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](hhttps://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121230-official-ets2-convoy-october-2026/)**!

featured.name: TruckersFM11 - Festival #TFM11
featured.description:
# **Welcome to TruckersFM's 11th Anniversary Festival! 🎉**
To celebrate TruckersFM turning 11 years old, we're throwing a one-of-a-kind party! Over the weekend, there will be loads to get involved with both in-game, and on-air.  
Want to come and join the celebrations? Dial in the radio to TruckersFM and come join us at our festival!

![TFM11 Festival Map](https://i.ibb.co/yFNvVcvG/tfm11-festival.jpg)

> **Server opens:** 17:00 BST  
**Festival starts:** 18:00 BST  
**Festival ends:** 23:00 BST  
**Location:** TruckersFM 11 City (located near London, UK)

---

At the festival, why not come and get involved with all of our events? There might even be prizes to be won!

## Bash the Bin
**Time:** TBC  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
Ever played TMP's "Knock the cone"? This is our twist on it! In front of you is a drag strip, with 3 bins lined up in a triangle at the end. The aim of the game is to bash the front bin (marked by the first of the two white lines) WITHOUT bashing the rear two bins (marked by the second of the two white lines). If you bash the rear bins (or cross the second line), you're out! The first to bash the first bin but not the second is the winner!  
![](https://i.ibb.co/RkhpLQj5/eut2-hq-6ac554ee.jpg)

## Off-road track
**Time:** TBC  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
Are you feeling adventurous? Why not take on the off-road track challenge! In this event, you'll be timed around our specially made off-road course, located in the TFM11 Quarry. There will be many challenges, on this course which will test the limits of your driving skills! You'll want to make a quicksave before taking part, as vehicle damage is guaranteed! How quickly can you get round the course?  
![](https://i.ibb.co/KpH3Tp6D/eut2-hq-6ac557ef.jpg)

## Race Track
**Time:** TBC  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
The ultimate test of speed! Bring out your fastest truck and race other players on our all new race track! Filled with exciting corners, straights, and lots of space for showing off your speed, the race track will crown the quickest drivers of the night! Be careful though, it's easy to flip a truck if you're cornering too fast!  
![](https://i.ibb.co/ZR4CpZV3/eut2-hq-6ac55888.jpg)

---

And there's so much more fun we haven't mentioned, such as the main stage where you can come and vibe with our staff & partners at TruckersMP! We can't wait to see you there, celebrating 11 Years of broadcasting!

## **[Why not also check out the #TFM11 Convoy?](https://truckersmp.com/events/35194)**

**Zasady wydarzenia dla uczestników:**

- Tylko zatwierdzeni Event Staff są uprawnieni do używania następujących słów lub fraz w swoim player tag; „CES |”, „CES | MEDIA TEAM” lub podobnych.
- Reklamowanie jest zabronione.
- Podszywanie się pod Event Staff przy użyciu wyżej wymienionych tagów jest zabronione.
- Uczestnicy muszą stosować się do poleceń Event Staff.
- Uczestnicy powinni parkować na wyznaczonych miejscach. Jeśli nie masz przydzielonego miejsca, musisz zaparkować w strefie „Public Parking”.
- Wyprzedzanie jest zabronione.
- Samochody osobowe są zabronione, z wyjątkiem Event Staff posiadających wyraźny tag.
- Uczestnicy muszą ciągnąć naczepę. (Z wyjątkiem Event Staff)
- Konfiguracje z podwójnymi naczepami, potrójnymi naczepami oraz zestawy HCT są zabronione. (Z wyjątkiem Event Staff)
- Swobodna jazda po serwerze („free roaming”) jest zabroniona.
- Obowiązują również wszystkie pozostałe zasady TruckersMP.

**Zasady wydarzenia dla Event Staff:**

- Event Staff wyprzedzający konwój mogą robić to maksymalnie w 2 osoby jednocześnie.
- Event Staff mogą jechać pod prąd wyłącznie na drogach posiadających centralną barierę rozdzielającą jezdnie. Zgodnie z zasadą powyżej.
- Event Staff mogą blokować skrzyżowania oraz drogi dojazdowe do skrzyżowań w celu kierowania konwojem.
- Event Staff mogą parkować poza wyznaczonym obszarem, pod warunkiem że pojazd stoi na ziemi, a nie na budynkach lub innych nieodpowiednich miejscach uznanych za niewłaściwe przez administrację TruckersMP.
- Obowiązują również wszystkie pozostałe zasady TruckersMP.

-----

**Event Rules for Participants:**

- Only approved Event Staff are able to use the following words or phrases in their player tag; “CES |, CES | MEDIA TEAM“ or similar.
- Advertising is prohibited.
- Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.
- Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
- Participants should park at their designated slots. If you do not have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
- Overtaking is prohibited.
- Cars are prohibited except for Event Staff showing a clear tag.
- Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)
- Double trailers, Triple trailers and HCT trailers configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.

**Event Rules for Event Staff:**

- Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
- Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
- Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
- Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.
